<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

List the chats of a running sandbox, newest first: their number and key for "codeflower attach", their title, when they last changed, whether they work or wait for you, and whether their terminal UI runs.

Without SANDBOX, and with more than one running, it lists the sandboxes.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower chats [SANDBOX] [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` |  | print JSON, with the chats' keys |
